column1: # Prefix table: how every CURIE in the GPAD and GPI files becomes an IRI.
#   prefix  the prefix as it appears in GPAD/GPI (case-sensitive)
#   target  an IRI base the local part is appended to;
#           =OTHER to treat the prefix as an alias of OTHER;
#           - to drop identifiers with this prefix on purpose (counted, not an error)
#           strip_version  remove a trailing .N version (Ensembl gene versions)
#           strip=TEXT     remove TEXT from the start of the local part
#   basis   where the target comes from
# Policy: use the Biolink Model prefix map (commit bec6cc5b, the one babel-rdf
# uses) wherever it has the prefix, so identifiers join with Babel, ROBOKOP and
# the other OKN graphs built from it. Otherwise use GO's own IRI where GO owns
# the identifier space (GO_REF, GO-CAM models), and an identifiers.org IRI in
# Biolink's style for the remaining long tail.
# Every local part that repeats its own prefix ("MGI:MGI:97486",
# "HGNC:HGNC:5") is shortened first ("MGI:97486"), as Biolink and Babel
# write those CURIEs. A local part left with a ':' under an OBO-style base
# (one ending in "_") is refused rather than written. UniProtKB isoforms (P12345-2) go to UniProtKB.isoform
